integrity: Self-contained proof and independent finite checker calculations are included. Finite checker sampling does not certify the all-parameter theorem. Originality is assessed only relative to inspected accessible sources.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only ordered, endpoint-fixed Bernstein sampling operators in polynomial degrees two and three and positive-semidefinite isotropic kernels on the circle; it does not classify higher degrees or strict positivity. Previously published but unindexed nonuniform-node theorems remain a possibility.
title: Quadratic rigidity and cubic node freedom for positive-definite Bernstein interpolation on the circle
